header.title: Automations
header.subtitle: Rules that answer, tag, and follow up on their own — so your team only handles what needs a human.

gate.title: Automation Gate is not connected
gate.body: No incoming message has ever reached the engine. The Gate node has to be imported into your n8n Core-AI-Brain workflow by hand — until then rules are saved but never fire.
gate.hint: Copy the node from docs/n8n-JSON and import it in n8n, then send a test message.
gate.noRulesBody: This log fills up once a rule can fire. Create your first automation, then send a test message — the connection is not the problem here.

empty.title: No automation rules yet
empty.subtitle: Start from a ready-made template below, or build one from scratch.
empty.noMatchHint: Try clearing the search or choosing another agent.

confirm.deleteBody: "{{name}}" will stop firing immediately. Its run history is kept for the activity log.
confirm.toggleFailed: Could not change the rule status.

message.received.label: Any message received
message.received.description: Fires on every incoming message, whatever it says.

keyword.match.label: Keyword match
keyword.match.description: Fires when the message contains, equals, or matches a pattern.

conversation.first_message.label: First message from a customer
conversation.first_message.description: Fires once, when someone writes for the first time.

comment.created.label: Comment on a post
comment.created.description: Fires when someone comments on your Facebook or Instagram post.

schedule.outside_business_hours.label: Outside business hours
schedule.outside_business_hours.description: Fires when a message arrives outside the hours you set.

session.idle.label: Conversation goes quiet
session.idle.description: Fires when a customer stops replying for a while.

order.created.label: Order placed
order.created.description: Fires when a new order is created.

order.status_changed.label: Order status changed
order.status_changed.description: Fires when an order moves to a status you pick.

cart.abandoned.label: Cart abandoned
cart.abandoned.description: Fires when a customer showed interest but never ordered.

handover.requested.label: Human requested
handover.requested.description: Fires when a customer asks for a human, or the AI escalates.

ai.paused.label: AI paused
ai.paused.description: Fires when the AI is switched off for a conversation.

lead.status_changed.label: Lead status changed
lead.status_changed.description: Fires when the AI reclassifies a customer.

sentiment.changed.label: Sentiment changed
sentiment.changed.description: Fires when a conversation turns angry or delighted.

tag.added.label: Tag added
tag.added.description: Fires when a tag is applied to a conversation.

triggerFields.commentKeywords: Words to watch for in comments. Leave empty to reply to every comment.
triggerFields.onlyActive: Only conversations the AI is handling
triggerFields.businessHoursFallback: Defaults to the hours in Settings → Business Settings.

actionFields.caption: Caption
actionFields.title: Title
actionFields.subject: Subject
actionFields.variables: Personalise with a variable written inside double curly braces — name, phone, address, district, order_id, order_total, product, page_name or agent_name.
actionFields.maxThreeButtons: Up to three buttons. Each one is sent as its own row.
actionFields.singleOperatorFallback: Assigns to you — team members arrive in a later release.

gallery.title: Start from a template
gallery.subtitle: Pre-built rules you can adapt in a minute.

builder.subtitle: Three steps: what starts it, what it must match, and what happens.
builder.nameRequired: Give the rule a name before saving.
builder.stopOnMatch: Stop checking other rules after this one matches
builder.noConditions: No conditions — this rule runs for every matching trigger.
builder.noActions: Add at least one action, or the rule can never reply.
builder.noTemplates: No templates yet — create one under Templates first.
builder.quietHoursHint: Rules stay silent during these hours.
builder.frequencyCapHint: Stops one customer being messaged repeatedly.

test.title: Test this rule
test.subtitle: Nothing is sent and nothing is saved — this only shows what would happen.
test.suppressedByHuman: A human owns this conversation, so the reply is held back.
test.continueWithAi: The AI will carry on after this reply.

runs.title: Run history
runs.empty: This rule has not run yet.

activity.title: Activity Log
activity.subtitle: Every rule that was checked, what it decided, and why it stayed quiet.
activity.loadFailed: Could not load the activity log.
activity.empty: Nothing has run in this period
activity.emptyHint: Every time a rule is evaluated it is recorded here, whether it replied or was held back.
activity.emptyFilteredHint: Try a longer date range or clear the filters — the runs are there, they just do not match.

templates.title: Templates
templates.pageSubtitle: Reusable message copy — and on WhatsApp, the only way to start a conversation.
templates.subtitle: Reusable message copy. WhatsApp only delivers a business-initiated message that uses an approved template.
templates.name: Template name
templates.bodyPlaceholder: Hi there, your order is confirmed.
templates.bodyRequired: A template needs a message body.
templates.headerValueRequired: The header you chose needs a value.
templates.noButtons: Optional. Up to three, sent as separate rows.
templates.buttonValueRequired: A website or phone button needs a destination.
templates.approvalHint: Driplare does not submit templates to Meta yet — copy the status across from WhatsApp Manager so broadcasts know what they can use.
templates.approvalWillReset: You changed the message text, so this template goes back to “not submitted” — Meta approves the exact wording, so a new text needs a new approval.
templates.archiveHint: Archive — hides it from pickers, keeps existing sends working
templates.emptyHint: Write a message once and reuse it in rules and broadcasts. On WhatsApp an approved template is the only way to message someone who has not written to you recently.
templates.emptyFilteredHint: Try a different word, or clear the filters.
templates.deleteBody: "{{name}}" will be removed permanently. Rules that used it will need a new message.

broadcasts.title: Broadcasts
broadcasts.pageSubtitle: One message to many customers — offers, restocks and delivery notices.
broadcasts.subtitle: One message to many customers. It cannot be recalled once it starts sending.
broadcasts.name: Broadcast name
broadcasts.templateRequired: WhatsApp needs an approved template for this — pick one below.
broadcasts.templateNotApproved: This template is not marked approved. WhatsApp rejects a business-initiated message that uses an unapproved template, so every recipient outside the 24-hour window will fail.
broadcasts.bodyHint: These are filled in per customer: {{list}}
broadcasts.bodyRequired: There is no message to send.
broadcasts.noTags: No tags yet — create them from a rule's “Add a tag” action.
broadcasts.recencyHint: Anyone quieter than this is left out — messaging someone who has not written in months is what gets a WhatsApp number reported.
broadcasts.noFilters: No filters — this reaches every contact who can be messaged. Add a tag or a recency filter unless you really mean everyone.
broadcasts.unreachable: {{count}} of these cannot receive a push message (web widget visitors) and are left out.
broadcasts.scheduledHint: Leave empty to keep it as a draft. The audience is resolved at send time, so people who unsubscribe in between are skipped.
broadcasts.confirmBody: This cannot be undone or recalled. Each customer receives the message once.
broadcasts.emptyHint: A broadcast is one message to many customers at once — an offer, a restock, a delivery notice. On WhatsApp it must use an approved template unless the customer wrote to you in the last 24 hours.
broadcasts.emptyFilteredHint: Try another status, or clear the filter.
broadcasts.deleteBody: "{{name}}" will be removed. Nothing has been sent to anyone yet.

skipReasons.missing_recipient: No recipient id on this conversation
skipReasons.comment_session: Comments cannot receive a direct message

welcome_first_message.name: Welcome new customers

keyword_price.name: Price question

idle_follow_up.name: Follow up when they go quiet
idle_follow_up.description: One gentle nudge if a customer stops replying.

comment_to_dm.description: Reply to a comment and send the details privately.

comment_thanks.name: Thank every commenter
comment_thanks.description: A short thank-you on every comment, no keyword needed.

order_confirmation.description: Send the order number and total as soon as an order lands.

cod_confirm.name: COD confirmation
cod_confirm.description: Ask the customer to confirm a cash-on-delivery order.

order_shipped.name: Order shipped
order_shipped.description: Tell the customer their parcel is on the way.

order_delivered.name: Order delivered
order_delivered.description: Confirm delivery and mark the customer as successful.

cart_abandoned.name: Abandoned cart
cart_abandoned.description: Remind someone about the products they left behind.

human_handover.name: Human handover
human_handover.description: Pause the AI and alert you when a customer asks for a person.

negative_sentiment.name: Unhappy customer
negative_sentiment.description: Flag and tag conversations that turn negative.

vip_prospect.name: High-value prospect
vip_prospect.description: Tag and alert you when the AI spots a serious buyer.

order_high_value_alert.name: High-value order alert
order_high_value_alert.description: Notify you about orders above a set amount.
